children: Brazil's central bank is approaching data with "humility" given the unusually high level of uncertainty surrounding the economic outlook, governor Gabriel Galipolo said on Thursday.
Speaking at a press conference, Galipolo said policymakers cannot rely on a "false sense of precision" when assessing the inflation outlook.
